form.waitingUpload: Waiting for the file upload to finish.
form.answerEveryRequired: Answer every required question to continue.
form.noQuestions: This form has no questions yet.
form.pressLetterToggle: Press a letter to toggle an option.
form.pressNumberToggle: Press a number to toggle an option.
form.draftSaved: Your answers are saved on this device so you can finish later.
form.draftChanged: This form has changed since you started, so a few of your saved answers no longer fit it and were cleared.
form.headerImageFailed: Header image could not be loaded. The form is still available.
form.sealedNote: It was sealed to this form's key before it left your browser.
form.editLinkNote: Save this link to edit your response later; it won't be shown again.
form.footerSeal: Encrypted in your browser. Only authorized collaborators can read this.
form.notAccepting: This form is not accepting responses
form.oneResponse: This form only accepts one response per person.
form.tooLong: Your answers are too long to send. Shorten your longest answer and try again.
form.submitFailed: Something went wrong submitting your response.
form.saveFailed: Something went wrong saving your changes. This link may have expired.
form.fontFailed: A selected font could not be loaded. Using its role default instead.

common.vaultInitFailed: Could not initialize your secure vault. Try again.
common.tooManyWait: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

errors.checkoutInProgress: Your payment is still being confirmed. Reload this page in a minute.
errors.activeSubscription: Cancel the subscription before deleting this account

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Your password never leaves this device. Only a one-way verifier derived from it is sent, and the key it unlocks stays here.
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Your account is created once you enter it.
signup.codeRejected: That code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
signup.resendSent: A new code is on its way.
signup.resendWait: Wait a minute before asking for another code.

login.title: Log in
login.twoFactorBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.codeRejected: That code was not accepted. Enter your password again.
login.tooManySignIn: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and sign in again.

unlock.title: Unlock your account
unlock.body: Enter your password to decrypt your data on this device.
unlock.unlockFailed: Could not unlock your account. Try again.
unlock.sessionLoadFailed: Could not load your session. Reload and try again.

recover.startBody: You'll need the recovery code you saved when you created your account. Without it, this will not work: there is no other way to recover an encrypted vault.
recover.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed to {email} and your printed recovery code.
recover.authenticatorHint: Only if you have two-factor authentication enabled.
recover.genericVerifyFailure: That combination wasn't accepted. Check both codes and try again.
recover.passwordBody: Your existing forms and responses stay exactly as they are. A new recovery code is issued once this is done, and the old one stops working.

recoveryCard.title: Save your recovery code
recoveryCard.body: This is the only time it is shown. If you forget your password, this code is the only thing that can recover your forms and responses; without it they stay encrypted forever.
recoveryCard.copyFailedHint: Select the code and copy it manually.
recoveryCard.notTwoFactor: This is not a two-factor recovery code. Two-factor codes get you back into your account when you lose your authenticator; they cannot decrypt anything. This one decrypts your vault and does nothing for signing in.
recoveryCard.acknowledge: I have saved this code somewhere safe. I understand it will not be shown again.
recoveryCard.fileBody:
This recovers your encrypted forms and responses if you forget your
password. It is not a two-factor recovery code. Keep it somewhere
only you can reach. Nobody can reissue it.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.heading: Nothing here to unseal.
notFound.body: This page does not exist, or its link was copied incompletely. A form link carries its key after the hash sign, and stops working when that part is cut off, so check the whole address made it across.

incompleteLink.title: This link is incomplete
incompleteLink.description: The part after the hash sign is the key that decrypts the form, and it did not make it into this address. Ask whoever shared the link to send the whole thing.

incompleteEditLink.title: This link is incomplete
incompleteEditLink.description: An edit link carries both your edit token and the form's key after the hash sign, and this address is missing one of them. Open the link exactly as it was saved.

formGone.title: This form no longer exists
formGone.description: Its owner has deleted it, or the address is wrong. Nothing you submitted earlier is affected.

wrongKey.title: This key does not open this form
wrongKey.description: The form loaded, but the key in the link could not decrypt it. The link was probably altered when it was copied. Ask for it to be sent again.

keyMismatch.title: This form cannot be trusted right now
keyMismatch.description: The key your answers would be encrypted to is not the one this form's owner set up, so someone other than the owner might be able to read them. Nothing has been sent. Let the person who shared the link know.

unreachable.title: This form could not be loaded
unreachable.description: Something interrupted the request. Check your connection and try again.

rateLimited.title: Too many people opened this form at once
rateLimited.description: Wait a minute, then reload the page.

formUnavailable.title: This form is no longer available
formUnavailable.description: It was deleted, or your access to it was removed. It will not appear in your dashboard any more.

keysPending.title: Waiting for the owner
keysPending.description: You have accepted this form, but its keys are handed over the next time the owner opens their dashboard. Nothing is wrong; come back once they have.

keysUnreadable.title: This form could not be opened
keysUnreadable.description: Its keys did not open with your account. Reloading usually clears this; if it keeps happening, ask the owner to share the form with you again.

formsListUnreachable.title: Your forms could not be loaded
formsListUnreachable.description: Something interrupted the request. Check your connection and try again.
